note: Migrated to WebGPURenderer + TSL. The workflow itself died mid-round — all six agents finished their edits then expired on terminal API errors, and the pipeline hung ~12h waiting on one that never returned; the work was recovered from disk and integrated by hand. Every piece moved except the one that mattered most. Measured wins: the round-1 frame flood is gone (idle corners 177/147 -> ~0, blown pixels 1.91% -> 0.27% against the plate's 0.115%), and the flesh now has a real pale pith band at 5.3x the rind value where round 1 had none at all. The juice scored 0 delta: the fast-flick and slow-cleave frames measure as the same fluid in kind, and the critic found why — the fat juice-tinted spray budget GROWS with stroke speed, the exact inverse of the intent. Hero framing was fixed by hand afterwards: 30.0% -> 39.4% of frame height.
